title: Figure 7: H5 Output Section with Point Geometry Converter and Ground-Plane Antenna
description: Color close-up photograph of the H5 high-power microwave source output section, with a flanged coaxial section feeding a wedge-shaped horn and a flat metal ground-plane antenna in a lab. The caption reads "Figure 7. H5 Output Section With the Point Geometry Converter Feeding an Extended-Ground-Plane Antenna Through a Brewster Angle Window." The text describes testing at the High Energy Research and Test Facility and the AFRL Phoenix UWB source.
